about: The release merged manifest of composeApp (the 1.5.0 release line). Phase 6a added ML Kit Document Scanner 16.0.0 and reviewed the diff: it adds three components (an invisible delegate activity, an init provider and a discovery service), all exported=false, and no permission, feature or exported component. Phase 7b (Part II reminders) added WorkManager 2.11.2 and the notification permission and reviewed the diff: two permissions (POST_NOTIFICATIONS, declared by the app; RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, from WorkManager) and two exported components, both from WorkManager and both guarded by a permission only the system or the shell holds. WorkManager's automatic start-up entry is removed (it starts on demand). check_merged_manifest.py compares the manifest with this file; a change is a reviewed edit here with a reason. Nothing here is camera, storage, media or location.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics (sanitized telemetry only) and RevenueCat billing, via play-services-measurement. No payslip data is sent.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement): sends only when a network exists.

permissions.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement): keeps the device awake while it uploads a batch.

permissions.name: com.google.android.finsky.permission.BIND_GET_INSTALL_REFERRER_SERVICE
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement): reads the Play install referrer.

permissions.name: com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement-impl): the advertising-ID permission Play Console asks the app to declare.

permissions.name: com.android.vending.BILLING
permissions.reason: Play Billing (billing 8.3.0, via RevenueCat): Premium purchases.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.reason: Play Asset Delivery (asset-delivery 2.2.2): the foreground service that extracts the Gemma model pack.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
permissions.reason: Play Asset Delivery: the data-sync foreground service type for the same extraction (targetSdk 34+).

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement-api): Android Privacy Sandbox attribution.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID
permissions.reason: Firebase Analytics (play-services-measurement-api): Android Privacy Sandbox advertising ID.

permissions.name: in.aiborne.payslipmax.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
permissions.reason: androidx.core 1.16: the app's own signature permission that keeps dynamically registered receivers private.

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.reason: Part II reminders (Phase 7b), declared by the app: the runtime permission Android 13+ asks for before a notification can show. It is asked once, after the app's own explainer and only when a printed slip first sets a reminder (DECISIONS Round 28); a decline is final. The notification is one generic sentence.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
permissions.reason: androidx.work (work-runtime 2.11.2): lets WorkManager re-register its pending jobs after a reboot, so a scheduled Part II reminder survives a restart. Only the system sends that broadcast.

declared_permissions.name: in.aiborne.payslipmax.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
declared_permissions.reason: androidx.core 1.16: signature level, so only this app can hold it.

exported_components.name: com.payslipmax.pdfparser.MainActivity
exported_components.reason: The launcher activity (MAIN/LAUNCHER filter): the app's only entry point.

exported_components.name: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
exported_components.reason: androidx.profileinstaller (baseline profiles): exported so adb and Play can trigger profile installation, guarded by android.permission.DUMP, which only the shell and the system hold.

exported_components.name: com.google.android.play.core.assetpacks.AssetPackExtractionService
exported_components.reason: Play Asset Delivery (asset-delivery 2.2.2): the library ships it exported but disabled; Play turns it on when it extracts an asset pack (the Gemma model pack).

exported_components.name: androidx.work.impl.diagnostics.DiagnosticsReceiver
exported_components.reason: androidx.work (work-runtime 2.11.2): an adb diagnostics broadcast, exported but guarded by android.permission.DUMP, which only the shell and the system hold. It reports WorkManager's own job counts to adb and sends nothing out.

exported_components.name: androidx.work.impl.background.systemjob.SystemJobService
exported_components.reason: androidx.work (work-runtime 2.11.2): the JobScheduler service WorkManager runs its jobs on. Exported so the system can bind it, guarded by android.permission.BIND_JOB_SERVICE, which only the system holds. The reminder worker runs inside it.
